message: docs: retire obsolete compatibility and branch prerequisites from deferred coverage

replacements.old: Protocol upgrades must preserve application identities and idempotency.
replacements.new: Changes to the supported external harness protocol must preserve application identities and idempotency; this is not a requirement for earlier OpenLegend schemas or adapters.

replacements.old: Add regression coverage for JSON-cache migration, database top-N ordering, actor/model isolation, corrections/forgetting, and unavailable embeddings;
replacements.new: Add regression coverage for current-format vector storage, database top-N ordering, actor/model isolation, corrections/forgetting, and unavailable embeddings;

replacements.old: Legacy imports preserve over-quota content and reject workspace dispatch until reconciled, rather than truncating it.
replacements.new: Reject incompatible or over-quota workspace input without truncating retained content; do not add legacy import or conversion coverage.

replacements.old: Configure a dedicated production database, rehearse the preserved-save import, and verify capped live embeddings/reflection with the configured BYOK provider. Disposable runtime checks do not establish full migration or workspace/provider acceptance.
replacements.new: Configure a dedicated production database, rehearse recovery from a preserved current-format operational backup, and verify capped live embeddings/reflection with the configured BYOK provider. Disposable runtime checks do not establish production recovery or workspace/provider acceptance.

replacements.new: Preserve commitment completion/deadline ordering; current navigation support, clearance and deterministic route behavior belong to SR16–SR17, not the removed lattice algorithm’s numeric tie-breaking.

replacements.old: After outstanding action-repertoire/hearing/spatial branches merge, exercise their response schemas, event attribution and encounter hooks with CR13/BW08; do not duplicate their executors.
replacements.new: Exercise the integrated action-repertoire, hearing and spatial response schemas, event attribution and encounter hooks with CR13/BW08. Those branch integrations are present; remaining combined qualification must not be blocked on merging them again or duplicate their executors.

replacements.old: stable contacts do not repeat, and saved upgrades preserve identity and unrelated evidence.
replacements.new: stable contacts do not repeat, and current-format save/restore preserves identity and unrelated evidence.
